findings.location: ## Definition, encoder equation and decoder residual description (lines 40–42)
findings.evidence: The encoder equation adds MHA(X,X,X) to X, and the decoder description adds each attention output to a width-d residual input. The direct MHA supplier allows arbitrary output width d_o (def-multihead-self-attention, lines 27 and 36), so these additions are undefined unless each attention sublayer has output width d. The Definition does not state this condition. Specify d_o=d for encoder self-attention, decoder self-attention, and decoder cross-attention. This draft supplier is in current-run batch 36.
